description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEntityConditionCache' that manages caching of entity conditions and related data within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving, storing, and removing cache entries, as well as handling cache invalidation upon entity updates.

classes.name: AbstractEntityConditionCache
classes.description: An abstract cache class for entity conditions, providing mechanisms to cache, retrieve, and invalidate cache entries based on entity conditions and entity metadata.

methods.name: get

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache for a specific entity, condition, and key, respecting the entity's caching policy.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all cache entries related to a specific entity.

methods.description: Removes cache entries for a specific entity and condition.

methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry identified by entity, condition, and key.

methods.description: Returns a frozen (immutable) version of the condition.

methods.name: getConditionCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache map for a specific entity and condition.

methods.name: getOrCreateConditionCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the cache map for a specific entity and condition.
